correctness.rationale: For any 2n-support, complementary n-subset pairs produce a cross-polytope boundary ∂C_d, d=binom(2n,n)/2, p=d−1. The witness facet replaces two special n-subsets of [2n−1] by their complements, with full union S and no additional n-subset meeting all face vertices, so its integral cochain is a cocycle taking value ±1 on exactly its own sphere; dual evaluations produce a split, primitive lattice in global H_p. Under a transposition, permutation determinant on all n-subsets is +1, while determinant on complementary-pair sums is (-1)^{binom(2n−2,n−1)/2}; v2 of central binomial equals binary digit sum of n−1, so the sign exponent is 1 iff n−1 a power of two. Induction from support stabilizer gives the integral induced module. A finite-group rational averaging argument gives nonzero quotient homology when eps=0, while published beta9=binom(m,6) yields complete rational triple module. Direct determinant and facet checks corroborated but do not replace all-n proof.
